name: How much does a second-story addition typically cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a second-story addition typically cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a second-story addition in Los Angeles varies widely based on size, complexity, materials, and finishes. Factors like structural engineering, foundation work, plumbing, and electrical extensions contribute significantly. While a precise estimate requires a detailed assessment, clients can expect investments starting from several hundred thousand dollars, reflecting the scale and luxury finishes typical for our projects. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after initial consultations.
